summary: Public projects created on 28 April 2026: 35 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Claude Code plugins for managing infrastructure such as OPNsense, Proxmox, Synology and Home Assistant, alongside plugins for scheduling, decision frameworks, browser data capture, image annotation and Jewish utilities. Documentation repositories cover AI workspace primitives, from budget and secrets manifests to style and process guides. A Jerusalem air-quality dataset accompanies related analysis.
